claims: 21 unique ads produced in ~5 minutes from one body + 21 hooks
Claude noticed hook clips had different volume than the body and normalized it unprompted (screen: loudness -14.01 LUFS / -1.29 dB, identical SPS/PPS encoder params)
It screenshotted each hook to generate meaningful filenames (e.g. cap-cinematic-body, hyperfocus-cinematic, gut-check, thumbstopper)
Naming alone would take a media buyer ~30 minutes manually
how_to_steps: Record N hooks as separate clips; keep one edited 'body' ad
Prompt: 'I want you to take this body: <path to body.mp4> and combine it with every hook here: <hooks folder>. We should end with 21 videos.' Ask for a unique naming convention per hook+body
Claude checks specs (1080x1920, 30fps, h264), matches loudness, concatenates, verifies audio/video, writes hook-NN-<name>-body-edited.mp4
Next level: download your top ads from the ad account (last 90 days), have Claude split each into hook / body / CTA, then mix and match every element
